name: Sharwa margin Hegic option collateral valued by a Uniswap V3 spot quote
summary: Sharwa's HegicModule valued Hegic option NFTs held as margin collateral by quoting their USDC.e payoff through the Uniswap V3 Quoter on the thin USDC.e/USDC pool. In a flash loan the attacker skewed that pool so an option paying about 0.14 USDC.e counted as over 20,000 USDC of collateral, and borrowed USDC, WETH and WBTC from Sharwa's pools against it.
notes: Reset: MarginTrading.provideERC721 calls checkStrategy with the token pair reversed, so getStrategy returns address(0); setAvailebleStrategy(address(0), true), 9 seconds after the Hegic module route was set, is what admits any Hegic option as collateral.

The quoter path and exchanger are constructor values with no later setter calls. This redeployment's flaw differs from the October 2025 swap-solvency exploit of Sharwa's earlier contracts; the attacker's second attempt reverted.
Gross depletion of the USDC, WETH and WBTC pools by the three borrows, left as debt against an account holding only the 0.14 USDC.e option. WETH and WBTC at DefiLlama prices.
